historical_record.description: The two-family dwelling, zoned C-2 since 1960 as part of a larger parcel that once fronted Sacramento Street, was to be converted into offices for psychiatrists; the commercial buildings on the Sacramento frontage had been torn down and that part of the site stood vacant.
The lot holding the two-family dwelling was split from the commercial frontage on Sacramento Street, by a subdivision recorded on this date.

After three hearings and petitions from about 650 neighbours, the City Planning Commission unanimously refused, under discretionary review, the conversion of the two-unit dwelling into psychiatrists' offices, though the lot was zoned C-2 (Resolution 7463).
The Board of Permit Appeals, at its meeting of 22 December 1976, upheld the City Planning Commission's refusal of psychiatrists' offices in the building.
